name: Hell Creek Formation
modern_region: Montana; North Dakota; South Dakota; Wyoming, USA
description: Latest Cretaceous sedimentary formation of western North America and the main V1 ecosystem for T. rex, Triceratops, Edmontosaurus and Ankylosaurus.

name: Lance Formation
description: Latest Cretaceous formation of western North America containing fauna closely related to the Hell Creek ecosystem.

name: Horseshoe Canyon Formation
description: Late Cretaceous formation associated with older Edmontosaurus populations, especially Edmontosaurus regalis.

name: Western North America
description: Broad paleogeographic region inhabited by the four dinosaur accounts in V1.

name: Mammoth Steppe
modern_region: Northern Eurasia and northern North America
description: Cold, dry Pleistocene steppe-tundra biome dominated by grasses, sedges and herbaceous vegetation.

name: Beringia
description: Pleistocene land region connecting northeastern Asia and northwestern North America during periods of lower sea level.

name: Wrangel Island
description: Arctic island where an isolated woolly mammoth population survived until roughly 4,000 years ago.

name: Siberia
description: Major northern Eurasian region containing extensive woolly mammoth fossil and frozen remains.

name: Alaska
description: Major North American region inhabited by woolly mammoths during the Pleistocene.
